egypt-mediterranean-pearl-palaces.lead: Egypt beyond the Pyramids: Cairo’s Islamic heart, Alexandria’s Mediterranean shore and a Nile sail to Luxor.

reasons.t: Cairo on foot with an expert
reasons.d: Private architectural walks through Coptic Cairo and Saladin’s 12th-century Citadel, and an Al-Azhar Hill sundowner of Egyptian wines over a thousand minarets.
A stay at the Four Seasons San Stefano, a private after-hours visit to the Roman Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, and a seafood dinner on a private pier.

reasons.t: A dawn flight and a Nile sail
reasons.d: A dawn helicopter or balloon loop over the Alexandria coast landing for a champagne brunch in the Montaza Palace gardens, then the temples of Luxor and a sail aboard the Mövenpick Royal Lily.

egypt-pharaonic-kingdoms.lead: The classic Pharaonic route done without queues: VIP arrivals, after-hours museum access and a balloon over the Valley of the Kings.

reasons.d: A crowd-free Egyptologist tour of the Great Pyramid and Sphinx, and after-hours VIP access to the Grand Egyptian Museum, including the complete Tutankhamun collection.
A champagne sundowner from a private desert majlis tent facing the Pyramids as the sun sets behind them.
A dawn balloon over the Valley of the Kings, private entry to the tombs of Tutankhamun and Seti I, the Temple of Hatshepsut, and a stay aboard The Oberoi Zahra.

egypt-secret-oasis-hidden-tombs.lead: The Egypt most visitors miss: newly excavated tombs at Saqqara and a private flight to the salt-rock lodge at Siwa Oasis.

reasons.d: Private access to newly excavated noble tombs at Saqqara, then single malt whisky at sunset on a platform overlooking the Step Pyramid of Djoser.
A charter flight deep into the Western Desert to Adrère Amellal Eco-Lodge, a float in a hyper-saline desert lake, the Oracle Temple of Alexander the Great and a dawn balloon over the salt pans.
Luxor, Kom Ombo and Aswan, sailing aboard the Sonesta Star Goddess.

morocco-imperial-cities.lead: Four imperial cities and the Sahara in ten days, with a private flight that replaces a nine-hour desert road journey.

reasons.d: A sunset tour of the 14th-century Merenid Tombs above the medina, and the Chouara Tannery seen from a private viewing balcony.
A balloon over Erg Chebbi as the sands turn from purple to orange, then a white-linen champagne breakfast atop a 300-metre dune prepared by your private chef.
Todra Gorge’s 300-metre limestone walls, Aït Benhaddou on the Road of a Thousand Kasbahs, the Tizi n’Tichka Pass, and a finish at the Royal Mansour in Marrakech.

morocco-mediterranean-pearl.lead: Morocco’s northern and Atlantic coasts, a different country from the desert circuit: Tangier, the Blue City, Rabat and Essaouira.

reasons.d: A private yacht sail where the Mediterranean meets the Atlantic at the Strait of Gibraltar, with Spain in view, and a Cape Spartel sundowner with Moroccan sparkling wine.
A private walk with an architectural historian through the blue-washed streets of the old Andalusian quarter.

reasons.t: Rabat, and the coast from above
reasons.d: Hassan Tower and the Kasbah of the Udayas with a seafood bonfire dinner, a dawn balloon or helicopter over the Atlantic coast, and a hammam in Essaouira.

morocco-rif-saharan-oases.lead: Off Morocco’s main circuit: the Rif mountains, Roman Volubilis after hours, a hidden oasis retreat and the red arches of Legzira.

reasons.d: Volubilis to yourselves, with a vintage wine tasting on white linen between the basilica’s pillars, and Tetouan’s White Dove medina without the crowds.
A speedboat through deep red rock gorges on Lake Bin El Ouidane, then a balloon over the lake and Atlas foothills with a champagne brunch on a quiet peninsula.
A hidden retreat in the Skoura Oasis among 1,000 palm trees with a theatrical kasbah dinner, and a private charter to Mirleft to walk beneath the Legzira sandstone sea arches.

morocco-secret-oasis-atlas.lead: A Marrakech-based escape into the Atlas: camel safaris, lantern-lit canyon dinners and Kasbah Tamadot.

reasons.d: A private camel safari across the Agafay plains with the snow-capped Atlas on the horizon, then an open-air dinner in a stone canyon lit by hundreds of floating lanterns.
A sunrise balloon over the Atlas foothills with a farm-to-table breakfast in a mountain meadow, and the hidden Ourika Valley waterfalls with a naturalist and Barbary macaques.
Kasbah Tamadot has a heated infinity pool and Atlas panoramas, plus an argan and rose oil hammam, after nights at Royal Mansour and Inara Camp.

dubai-grand-luxury-experience.lead: Ten days in Dubai with VIP handling at every border and a private chauffeur throughout, from the Burj Khalifa to a desert camp under the stars.

reasons.t: VIP from the moment you land
reasons.d: A VIP meet-and-greet at every entry point with fast-tracked customs, and a private chauffeur for the whole journey.
A scenic helicopter flight over Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis and the coast, then the Burj Khalifa and the Dubai Fountain from above.
Dune bashing, sandboarding and a premium desert camp dinner, Old Dubai’s soul, and nine nights at the Fairmont Dubai on Sheikh Zayed Road.

new-zealand-and-fiji.lead: Mountains, then islands: Queenstown’s adventure country and Milford Sound, finishing barefoot on Malolo Island in Fiji.

reasons.d: Four nights at The Rees on Lake Wakatipu beneath the Remarkables, with a jet boat, bungy, zipline, skydive or rafting if you want them, and the Onsen Hot Pools if you don’t.
A private scenic helicopter flight over the Southern Alps with an alpine landing, then Fiordland National Park and a cruise through Milford Sound.
Fly to Fiji’s Mamanuca Islands for the final nights at Six Senses on Malolo Island.

new-zealand-grand-adventure.lead: New Zealand end to end: Auckland’s volcanic cones, Māori culture and geysers in Rotorua, Queenstown and the fiords.

reasons.d: A Māori cultural performance in a carved meeting house, a hāngi cooked beneath the earth, and the New Zealand Māori Arts and Crafts Institute at Te Puia.
The Pōhutu Geyser, the Champagne Pool, the Artist’s Palette and the Devil’s Bath, with two nights at Huka Lodge on the Waikato River.
Queenstown and the Southern Alps, the cruise through Milford Sound from Fiordland Lodge, and a finish at The George in Christchurch.
